name: The Veldt Escort Company
description: A highly disciplined escort and reconnaissance company operating from the Ubral highlands to the Vilikari Marches. They do not fight wars—they ensure safe passage for those who can pay, and for those who cannot, they provide a swift death. Their wolf-banner is known and feared in equal measure.
leverage: Guaranteed safe passage through contested passes, elite scout units, a network of watch-fires, and a reputation that deters bandits.
debtTrigger: When Obligation fills, the Company calls in a 'contract of blood'—a single dangerous mission to protect a specific caravan or eliminate a threat to their reputation.
quirk: Every member of the Company wears a single wolf's tooth on a leather thong. The tooth of a captain is always blackened by iron—a sign they have paid their blood-debt to the Company's code.
keyNPCs: Captain Kiran 'Gray-Mane' (disillusioned former Aelerian scout, speaks in eights and never lies)
Alina the Warden (master of signal fires and short routes)
Old Sokka (the only corporal who has never carried a weapon, but who has never lost a client)
hooks: A Vilikari factor offers a fortune for a safe route through a newly contested pass—but the Company's own scouts are refusing to take the contract.
A rival company is undercutting Veldt's prices and poisoning their wells. The Company needs 'unofficial' investigators.
Captain Gray-Mane has disappeared. His last signal was a single unlit beacon. He was tracking a herd of phase-panthers into the Mistlands.
